title: 第一卷 第25章 劝说
novel_title: 重回九八：我在小渔村兴风作浪
content_zh:
曾志明眯着小眼睛，笑呵呵的说道：“那不应该啊，阿青都往家里拿了一千块，说是阿华分给他一半，他没要，自个只要了一千。”

    巴拉巴拉。

    阿青是个憨的。

    心里不存什么事，有啥事都是和爸妈说，给了钱，也一五一十把事情交代的清清楚楚。

    所以。

    李华有时候出去耍，就不乐意带阿青。

    阿青心是好。

    可经常会坏事。

    薛凤和人话听曾志明这么说，也就不再藏着掖着，说道：“也是他们运气好才赚了钱。”

    “阿叔，你这来是……”

    曾志明看薛凤的反应，就知道后者是误会他是觉得分钱不均来要钱的，赶紧说道：“是这……阿华明天非要去滩涂地赶海。”

    “我觉得明天退大潮，礁石滩肯定还能抓到海参，劝他还去礁石滩，他死活不去。”

    “你和阿文去劝劝。”

    薛凤和任琴对视一眼，俩人点头。

    曾志明说的有道理。

    是该劝。

    “他为啥不去？”

    “说是人多，不想挤，你说刚赚点钱就嫌这嫌那，这可不是什么好兆头。”

    “阿叔说的是。”

    “你们去说说。”

    “要的。”

    正聊着，李文骑着自行车进院子，看到曾志明在，招呼了一声。

    薛凤看李文神色低沉，看起来心情不是很好，关切的问道：“出什么事？”

    李文摇摇头，低声说道：“今天我找老板预支工钱，老板没答应。”

    薛凤“哦”了一声，说道：“那就算了。”

    李文看向她：“可……”

    薛凤笑道：“阿华的事，你就别操心了。”

    李文一头雾水：“什么意思？”

    “我在外面就听到你们说阿华。”

    “他是又惹什么祸了？”

    曾志明笑道：“阿文这次阿华没惹祸，还做了件能轰天的事情。”

    李文诧异。

    轰天？

    不是捅破天吧？

    薛凤拉着他进屋。

    李文神色着急的询问李华干了什么事。

    薛凤没说话，而是从床头柜里面找出盒子，从盒子里把李华送来的五千块钱拿出来，叠的整整齐齐放在李文面前。
content_en:
Zeng Zhiming narrowed his eyes and said with a smile: "That shouldn't be the case. Ah Qingdu took a thousand yuan from home and said that Ah Hua gave him half of it. He didn't want it, so he only got one thousand yuan."

    Barabara.

    Ah Qing is a fool.

    I don't have anything in my heart. If I have anything, I just tell my parents. After I gave them the money, I explained everything clearly.

    so.

    Li Hua sometimes goes out to play, but he is not willing to take Ah Qing with him.

    Ah Qing has a good heart.

    But bad things often happen.

    After hearing what Zeng Zhiming said, Xue Feng and Renwen stopped hiding it and said, "They were also lucky enough to make money."

    "Uncle, what are you here for..."

    Seeing Xue Feng's reaction, Zeng Zhiming knew that the latter had misunderstood that he was asking for money because he felt the money was unevenly distributed. He quickly said: "That's it... Ah Hua has to go to the tidal flat to catch the sea tomorrow."

    "I think sea cucumbers will definitely be caught on the reef beach when the tide goes out tomorrow. I tried to persuade him to go to the reef beach, but he won't go there."

    "You and Awen go and persuade him."

    Xue Feng and Ren Qin looked at each other and nodded.

    What Zeng Zhiming said makes sense.

    It's time to advise.

    "Why doesn't he go?"

    "It's because there are so many people and I don't want to squeeze in. You said you just made some money and you don't like this or that. That's not a good sign."

    "That's what uncle said."

    "Go and talk."

    "I want it."

    While chatting, Li Wen rode his bicycle into the yard, saw Zeng Zhiming there, and said hello.

    Seeing Li Wen's downcast expression and not in a good mood, Xue Feng asked with concern: "What happened?"

    Li Wen shook his head and whispered: "Today I asked the boss to advance my salary, but the boss didn't agree."

    Xue Feng said "Oh" and said, "Forget it."

    Li Wen looked at her: "But..."

    Xue Feng smiled and said, "Don't worry about Ah Hua."

    Li Wen was confused: "What do you mean?"

    "I heard you talking about Ah Hua outside."

    "What trouble did he get into again?"

    Zeng Zhiming smiled and said: "Ah Wen and Ah Hua didn't cause any trouble this time, and they did something shocking."

    Li Wen was surprised.

    Boom?

    Isn't it a matter of breaking the news?

    Xue Feng pulled him into the house.

    Li Wen asked Li Hua anxiously what he had done.

    Xue Feng did not speak, but found a box from the bedside table, took out the five thousand yuan sent by Li Hua from the box, folded it neatly and placed it in front of Li Wen.
